description: This Java class implements a password encoder for Spring Security, supporting multiple hash functions (SHA-256, SHA-512, bcrypt) and utilizing SecureRandom for cryptographic operations. It provides methods to encode passwords and verify matches, configured with options for BCrypt strength and secure random initialization.

classes.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
classes.description: A Spring Security based password encoder supporting bcrypt, sha-256, and sha-512 hashing algorithms, with configurable strength and secure random source.

methods.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructs a new encoder with default bcrypt strength and a secure random generator.

methods.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructs a new encoder with specified bcrypt strength and a secure random generator.

methods.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructs a new encoder with specified secure random generator and bcrypt strength.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a raw password into a hashed password JSON object.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a raw password matches a stored hashed password JSON object.
